_comment: Marks the conflict stage reads (docs/librarian/LIBRARIAN.md, 'Evidence conflicts').
unspecifiedDamageKeywords: MGEF keywords saying an effect deals magic damage of no engine
element. On an effect that carries one, a framework keyword naming fire, frost, shock or
poison is contradicted by the record, and an element resting only on such keywords is
dropped. ResistMagic alone is NOT such a mark: the engine has no water, air or earth
resistance, so most mod elemental spells are resisted by ResistMagic.
Both names are one keyword (Update.esm|0x1EA6002, defined by Apostasy and by Ascension):
the load order's winning plugin decides its editor ID. The scan records keywords by
editor ID only, so it is named both ways here.
